summary: Backend refactor regression verification for the server.py + pdf_generator.py modular split. Ran full acceptance suite (5 files, 34 tests) with -o addopts= -p no:xdist and smoke-tested 23 GET endpoints. Result: 34/34 pytest PASS and 23/23 smoke endpoints return 2xx. Refactor is behaviour-preserving.

minor.issue: Returns 500 when called with the test session id because handler calls the real Emergent OAuth session-data URL (https://demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/session-data) which rejects a fake token. This is pre-existing behaviour (not a refactor regression); the Bearer-token path (GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer test_session_bitumen_2026) works correctly and is what all 34 regression tests use.

critical_code_review_comments: models.py holds ALL Pydantic models across every domain — this file will grow uncontrollably; consider splitting per domain (customers/trips/invoices/etc.) alongside routers/ to fully honour the modular intent.
services.py mixes trip math, invoice math, numbering and GST helpers. Splitting into services/trip.py, services/invoice.py, services/gst.py would improve locality with the corresponding routers.
pdf_generator.py compat shim is fine for now, but add a TODO/deprecation notice so future callers migrate to `from pdf import ...`.
Consider adding a lightweight /api/healthz endpoint — smoke checks currently rely on /api/companies which requires auth + company scoping.
seed_data_creation: None — tests self-provision via their own fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor of server.py (2660→79 lines) and pdf_generator.py (1030→shim) into routers/ + pdf/ + shared modules (db/models/auth/company/audit/services). All 34 acceptance tests pass, all smoke endpoints 2xx, multi-company isolation and PDF integrity (TAX INVOICE label, DejaVuSans ₹ glyph, revised T&C, column alignment) all verified through the existing iter17/21/22/23/multi_company_iso suites. Green light to ship. Only observation: models.py and services.py could be split further in a follow-up (non-blocking).
